The teal-edged column shifts its lean and fringed lower edge while purple banding intensifies.

caption: The video captures a night seascape where curtains of magenta and purple aurora ripple slowly across the sky above a flat, dark horizon. A bright vertical column of teal-edged light stands left of center, its lean and fringed lower edge shifting subtly as the display morphs. To the right, a sweeping arc deforms upward, its green lower boundary rising while the magenta above it spreads and reshapes. Faint purple banding on the left and the teal glow along the aurora's lower edges intensify gradually. Low clouds rest along the horizon line, and the calm near-black water keeps its position, catching only dim magenta reflections on the left. The aurora's slow, continuous rippling remains the dominant motion, the luminous structures still deforming rather than settling.
